modules.name: Kill Aura
modules.description: Attacks targets in reach, facing them first.

modules.name: Offhand
modules.description: Keeps a totem, crystal, golden apple or shield in your off hand.

modules.name: Auto Armor
modules.description: Wears your best armour, and swaps between chestplate and elytra on a bind.

modules.name: Velocity
modules.description: Reduces knockback and pushing.

modules.name: Auto Disconnect
modules.description: Leaves the server when you're about to die.

modules.name: Elytra Tweaks
modules.description: No Durability and a bind to start the glide.

modules.name: Rotation Lock
modules.description: Keeps you flying the way you faced, whatever the camera does.

modules.name: Elytra Fly
modules.description: Flies your elytra: bounces along highways, crosses open country, or flies with the movement keys.

modules.name: Rocket Boost
modules.description: While a rocket pushes you, flies as fast along your look as Grim allows: full speed at once, faster on diagonals.

modules.name: Inventory Move
modules.description: Lets you walk, jump and sprint with your inventory or a container open.

modules.name: No Slow
modules.description: Keeps your speed while eating or using items, and through cobwebs.

modules.name: Scaffold
modules.description: Keeps a block under you as you walk.

modules.name: Placement Tweaks
modules.description: Places blocks by hand the way you choose: facing, beside, against chests, in mid-air.

modules.name: Packet Mine
modules.description: Mines the blocks you hit for you, with your hand free.

modules.name: Nuker
modules.description: Breaks the blocks around you.

modules.name: Reach
modules.description: Lets you place blocks and hit entities from further away.

modules.name: Wall Interact
modules.description: Lets you hit entities and open containers through walls.

modules.name: Inventory Tweaks
modules.description: Opens shulker boxes from your inventory, and moves items with drags and the wheel.

modules.name: Replenish
modules.description: Refills hotbar stacks from your inventory.

modules.name: Middle Click
modules.description: Puts friends, experience, rockets or pearls on the middle mouse button.

modules.name: Auto Reconnect
modules.description: Joins the server you were on again after you're kicked or lose connection.

modules.name: Entity ESP
modules.description: Highlights players, mobs, crystals and more through walls.

modules.name: Tracers
modules.description: Draws lines to entities, storage and blocks.

modules.name: Nametags
modules.description: Draws readable name tags for players, mobs, items and pearls.

modules.name: Storage ESP
modules.description: Highlights chests, shulker boxes and other storage through walls.

modules.name: Block ESP
modules.description: Highlights the blocks you pick, like spawners or beds, through walls.

modules.name: Block Highlight
modules.description: Draws the block you're looking at in your own look, in place of vanilla's outline.

modules.name: Full Bright
modules.description: Lets you see in the dark.

modules.name: No Render
modules.description: Hides distracting effects, overlays and things.

modules.name: Time of Day
modules.description: Sets the time of day you see.

modules.name: View Model
modules.description: Moves, rotates, scales, hides or highlights your first-person hands.

modules.name: Zoom
modules.description: Zooms the camera in.

modules.name: Free Look
modules.description: Orbits the camera without turning your player; scroll to move it nearer or further.

modules.name: Freecam
modules.description: Detaches the camera so you can fly it around.

modules.name: Tooltips
modules.description: Adds container and map previews, durability and food values to tooltips.

modules.name: Chat
modules.description: Draws chat in the theme's font and colours, filtered, repeats stacked, more kept; Minecraft's Chat Settings here too.

modules.name: Extra Tab
modules.description: Draws the player list in Myriad's look: more players and rows, your pick of what's shown, friends, enemies and you picked out.

modules.name: Auto Eat
modules.description: Eats when your health or hunger gets low.

modules.name: Auto Tool
modules.description: Switches to the best tool for what you're mining.

modules.name: Auto Walk
modules.description: Walks forward without you holding the key.

modules.name: Anti AFK
modules.description: Swings and crouches while you're away, so the server doesn't kick you for idling.

modules.name: Auto Mend
modules.description: Mends your gear with bottles o' enchanting.

modules.name: Auto Sort
modules.description: Sorts containers as you open them.

modules.name: Auto Rename
modules.description: Renames items at an anvil in reach.

modules.name: Auto Craft
modules.description: Crafts items as many as you can, in your inventory or at a table in reach, from input containers into output ones.

modules.name: Villager Roller
modules.description: Rerolls a librarian until it sells the book you want.

modules.name: Auto Trader
modules.description: Trades with villagers from chests into chests: buys with emeralds, or sells them carrots, paper and the like.

modules.name: Auto Farmer
modules.description: Plants the crop you hold on empty farmland in reach.

modules.name: Junk Dropper
modules.description: Throws out items you've listed as junk as soon as you pick them up.

modules.name: Printer
modules.description: Builds Litematica schematics around you.

modules.name: Auto Portal
modules.description: Builds a Nether portal where you right-click with obsidian, or in front of you when turned on.
